steps.title: PostgreSQL Guardianships RLS Forced
steps.description: Verify stu.guardianships RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relname = 'guardianships' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Emergency Contacts RLS Enabled
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'core' AND c.relname = 'person_emergency_contacts' AND c.relrowsecurity = true
